inspection_scope: Original native worker and benchmark binaries inspected after measurement, before either was rebuilt.
limitations: Neither executable hash nor build metadata was captured in the original measurement receipt. This later inspection supports current binary/source correspondence but cannot retroactively prove the exact bytes executed during the twelve trials.
Go VCS metadata is an embedded build declaration, not independent build attestation.
The recovery integration tests compile separate helper/worker executables; this receipt does not bind those executable bytes.
Original measured JSON artifacts remain unchanged. Future harness runs record both executable hashes/build metadata and reject unverifiable source by default.
